front.title: A WebFinger Profile for Agent2Agent (A2A) Agent Identity Resolution

abstract.t: The Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol retrieves an agent's self-description (the Agent Card) from a fixed well-known URI, which resolves exactly one agent per origin and presumes the client already holds a URL. This document profiles WebFinger for A2A: an agent is named by an "acct" URI (agent@domain), and resolution of that name over WebFinger yields a link to the Agent Card of the endpoint that serves the agent -- the agent's own endpoint, or a gateway fronting it. The profile introduces no new link relation, media type, or registry: it composes three deployed standards and states how they fit.
